about: Hand checks of the answer key. Every expected line of every value-group case (changed defaults and raised minimum Python versions) was read in context, and each repository's docs were searched for statements the rules missed. drop_lines: lines that aren't statements of the changed value. add_lines: statements the rules missed. drop_cases: cases left with nothing to find.

notes.encode/httpx:raise_python:1: docs/async.md:26 is a tip about Python's own asyncio console, not httpx's minimum version.
notes.PyCQA/bandit:raise_python:1: faq.rst:10 is about the Python version of the project being scanned, not Bandit's minimum.
notes.simonw/sqlite-utils:raise_python:1: upgrading.rst:19 is under 'Upgrading from 3.x to 4.0': a historical requirement, still true for 4.0.
notes.sqlalchemy/alembic:raise_python:1: front.rst:80 is a versionchanged note (history); line 78 states the current minimum and was missed because of its bold text.
notes.sqlfluff/sqlfluff:raise_python:1: README.md:136 is about which wheel installs, not the minimum; the minimum is stated in AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md.
notes.coveragepy/coveragepy:raise_python:1: PyPy3 version 3.11 implements Python 3.11, so it stops being supported when the minimum rises.
notes.Kludex/uvicorn:change_default:1: The matched 0 could have come from '[0, jitter]', but the line ends with '**Default:** *0*', so it is right.

wrong: cookiecutter TimeExtension: a jinja2_time.TimeExtension line names another package's class
flask tests/conftest.py (2 lines): the tutorial means the reader's own project file
rules_added: a mention qualified by another package isn't counted

wrong: isort git_hook: the name is part of a link to docs/configuration/git_hook.md
loguru filter_by_level: a recipe defines its own helper; loguru's is in the private loguru/_filters.py
rules_added: an occurrence right after a slash is part of a path
only names defined in public modules are renamed
